No per-company/sample branches, API schema change, source threshold reduction, fine-tuning, private applicant reuse or production mutation.
Provisional final-* names from earlier candidates do not mean acceptance; all historical artifacts and failures are retained.

limits: Small development corpus and repeated executions are not an overall hiring accuracy estimate or a claim of perfect sentence coverage.
Some ambiguous cross-activity preparation fragments remain standalone evidence rather than updates to a prior question; original expected-partial failures remain visible.
A24-note ceiling can still omit later details in long, information-dense documents. Targeted later negotiation recognition is not a claim that every price/result statement was annotated.

Conservative uncertainty may omit useful facts: customer_support control r2 omits the concrete cancellation step at factual support .73; it is retained as an additional recall limitation, not silently reclassified as a correct negative. Explicit correction reinstatement is not comprehensively validated by this corpus.
Public frontend density and production performance were not deployed or browser-validated in this task.
The application simulates evidence-based reading, not an actual employer private judgment, personality assessment or hiring verdict.
